title: What the data can and cannot say
intro: Each card opens a published layer and year. Nothing is interpolated. Method-break years are labelled on the layer, not smoothed away.

stories.title: Religion is snapshots, not a continuous map
stories.can: Compare published 2011/2021 E&W affiliation, 2022 Scotland current religion (Area Overviews / Figure 2), and 2021 NISRA MS-B19. ITL1 England colours from sums of those published LA counts. Halton and East Midlands use the same catalog keys as the map polygons.
stories.cannot: There is no modern affiliation series before 2001, and 1851 worship-attendance is not this question. The three nations are not one Christian category. MS-B23 (religion brought up in) is not mixed in. NISRA has no standalone Muslim column.
breaks: 2022 Scotland census — not an E&W/NI year

stories.title: Birthplace, nationality, and ethnic group are three questions
stories.can: Put the three published questions side by side for the same place and year. Deep-link geo + geo2 for two-area compare. Scotland’s census year is 2022 — 2021 ethnicity/religion for Scotland stay blank.
stories.cannot: They cannot be added together or labelled “native”. Census national identity is not citizenship. UK-born is not White British.
breaks: APS household-survey stocks end YE June 2021 in this extract

stories.title: IPS-era and admin LTIM are two lines
stories.can: Show immigration, emigration, and net from the IPS-era 1964–2015 extract and, separately, admin-based LTIM from YE 2012. Emigration is a first-class series.
stories.cannot: The two methods are not one continuous net-migration line. Intentions (IPS) are not observed travel histories (admin). Do not splice 1964–2015 onto 2012–.

stories.title: Detections are not an illegal-entry stock
stories.can: Plot Home Office detected small-boat arrivals and other illegal-entry-route detections as published.
stories.cannot: This is not a count of people in the UK without permission, not undetected entries, and not visa overstays. The Home Office does not publish that stock.

stories.title: Fiscal estimates are methods, not one cost
stories.can: Filter cited MAC / OBR / Migration Observatory / Dustmann–Frattini figures by static vs dynamic, average vs marginal, public-goods allocation, and who is counted.
stories.cannot: The UI never averages them into a single true net fiscal cost of immigration. There is no official mapped cost layer.
breaks: Study window and public-goods allocation change the sign

stories.title: Ethnicity cannot be mapped before 1991
stories.can: Show E&W 2011/2021 high-level White, Scotland 2011/2022 headings, and NISRA MS-B01 2021 (White excludes Irish Traveller and Roma). 2021 E&W LAs and ITL1 roll-ups colour from published counts.
stories.cannot: There is no comparable UK ethnicity question before 1991. The three White headings are not one series. This extract has no 1991 counts to invent.
breaks: 1991 first ethnicity question (not in this extract)
